# PRO X Wireless Gaming Headset 046D:0ABA, headset switched off while its USB
# dongle is plugged in (the start-with-Windows case). Long-only collection
# FF43:0202, device index 0xFF.
#
# Shape from owner trace 2026-11-23: the dongle itself answers the ping, the
# feature lookups, the name ("PRO X Wireless Gaming Headset") and the device
# info (unit id FFFFFFFF); the 0x1F20 read (feature index 6, fn 0) fails with
# HID++ 2.0 error 0x05 (`11 FF FF 06 0B 05`) because the headset is off.
# Bytes the trace does not pin (protocol version, the other feature indexes,
# name chunking, device type 8) are synthetic, laid out per Linux
# drivers/hid/hid-logitech-hidpp.c and Solaar lib/logitech_receiver.
#
# Format: `out <short|long> <hex>` is a frame BatterySight writes, `in` one it
# reads; frames shorter than their role (7 / 20 bytes) are zero-padded. The
# `out` lines after an `in` are the writes that frame causes.

# Group arrival: ping index 0xFF; the dongle answers (protocol 4.2).
out long 11 FF 00 1B 00 00 5A
in  long 11 FF 00 1B 04 02 5A
# Root getFeature 0x0005 (name and type) -> index 2.
out long 11 FF 00 0B 00 05 00
in  long 11 FF 00 0B 02
# Root getFeature 0x0003 (device info, unit id) -> index 3.
out long 11 FF 00 0B 00 03 00
in  long 11 FF 00 0B 03
# Battery features 0x1004, 0x1000, 0x1001 absent; 0x1F20 at index 6.
out long 11 FF 00 0B 10 04 00
in  long 11 FF 00 0B 00
out long 11 FF 00 0B 10 00 00
in  long 11 FF 00 0B 00
out long 11 FF 00 0B 10 01 00
in  long 11 FF 00 0B 00
out long 11 FF 00 0B 1F 20 00
in  long 11 FF 00 0B 06
# 0x0005 fn 0: name length 29.
out long 11 FF 02 0B 00 00 00
in  long 11 FF 02 0B 1D
# 0x0005 fn 1 at offsets 0 and 16: "PRO X Wireless G" + "aming Headset".
out long 11 FF 02 1B 00 00 00
in  long 11 FF 02 1B 50 52 4F 20 58 20 57 69 72 65 6C 65 73 73 20 47
out long 11 FF 02 1B 10 00 00
in  long 11 FF 02 1B 61 6D 69 6E 67 20 48 65 61 64 73 65 74
# 0x0005 fn 2: device type 8 (headset).
out long 11 FF 02 2B 00 00 00
in  long 11 FF 02 2B 08
# 0x0003 fn 0: unit id FFFFFFFF in bytes 1..5.
out long 11 FF 03 0B 00 00 00
in  long 11 FF 03 0B 01 FF FF FF FF
# 0x1F20 fn 0: HID++ 2.0 error 0x05, the headset is off -> registered asleep.
out long 11 FF 06 0B 00 00 00
in  long 11 FF FF 06 0B 05
# The headset is switched on: 0x1F20 broadcast, 3828 mV discharging -> 68 %, no write.
in  long 11 FF 06 00 0E F4 01
